summary: Project-image OCR lifecycle support for DjangoLux 1.15 and ASCII-safe wrapper 4.
highlights: The optional OCR service joins generated restart and lifecycle allowlists; project-image updates include OCR with the application services.
Wrapper 4 keeps Windows PowerShell 5.1 launchers ASCII-safe and matches the DjangoLux scaffold.
Retains verified Composer 1.8 stable service protections and existing restart, recreate, update and maintenance behavior.
